description: CDISC Biomedical Concepts (COSMoS): standardized definitions of clinical measurements that a USDM activity can point at, with the field guide and an overview.
version: rolling export, pinned by commit; export dated 2026-07-21

notes.note: The CDISC Library COSMoS API returns 'Members-only content' on this subscription (401), so the Biomedical Concepts are taken from the public COSMoS repo export instead. The two doc files are process references, not data: 'Completion GLs' is the field dictionary for the BC export; 'Overview Training' is conceptual grounding.
notes.naming_exception: cdisc_biomedical_concepts_latest.xlsx is pinned as cdisc_biomedical_concepts.xlsx, the one departure from keeping the publisher's file name. CDISC's suffix says the file moves; this copy does not, and a pinned file named latest would contradict the pin every time the folder is read. The version is the commit above. Decided 2026-09-08.

files.name: cdisc_biomedical_concepts_latest.xlsx
files.role: The concept library itself, one row per Biomedical Concept parameter. Answers what standardized concept an activity measures; the code columns carry a LOINC code where the concept is a measurement.

files.name: BC_Curation_Principles_and_Completion_GLs.xlsx
files.path: bc_starter_package/doc/BC Curation Principles and Completion GLs.xlsx
files.role: The field dictionary for the library: what each column means and how CDISC populated it. Read before interpreting a column.

files.name: BC_Overview_Training.pdf
files.role: What a Biomedical Concept is, conceptually, and how it sits above SDTM and CDASH. Grounding only; the searchable PDF, not the slide deck.
